name: cyberprompt
description: Automatic prompt optimizer for Claude Code. A UserPromptSubmit hook intercepts every operator prompt, rewrites it via a non-agentic headless claude -p call armed with the bundled claude-5 prompting skill, validates the rewrite with deterministic gates, and injects it as an advisory contract — the original prompt stays authoritative. Fail-open by design, narrated by WORDRUNNER.EXE, levelled by an XP system.
